entries.title: Haggai 2:1
segments: In the seventh [month], in the twenty-first of the month, the word of the LORD came by the prophet Haggai, saying,

entries.title: Haggai 2:2
segments: Now speak to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

entries.title: Haggai 2:3
segments: Who [is] left among you who saw this house in her first glory? And how do you see it now? When compared to it, [is it] not as nothing in your eyes?

entries.title: Haggai 2:4
segments: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, says the LORD. And be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong all people of the land, says the LORD, and work; for I [am] with you, says the LORD of hosts

entries.title: Haggai 2:5
segments: [with the] Word who cut a covenant with you when you came out of Egypt, and My Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.

entries.title: Haggai 2:6
segments: For so says the LORD of hosts: Yet once, it [is] a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land.

entries.title: Haggai 2:7
segments: And I will shake all the nations; and the desire of all nations shall come; and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Haggai 2:8
segments: The silver [is] Mine, and the gold [is] Mine, says the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Haggai 2:9
segments: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than that of the former, says the LORD of hosts. And in this place I will give peace, says the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Haggai 2:10
segments: In the twenty-fourth of the ninth [month], in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

entries.title: Haggai 2:11
segments: So says the LORD of hosts: Now ask the priests the law, saying,

entries.title: Haggai 2:12
segments: If one carries holy flesh in the [skirt] of his garment, and touches his [skirt] to bread, or boiled food, or wine, or oil, or any food, will it become holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

entries.title: Haggai 2:13
segments: Then Haggai said, If [one] unclean of body touches these, is it unclean? And the priests answered and said, It is unclean.

entries.title: Haggai 2:14
segments: And Haggai answered and said, So [is] this people, and so [is] this nation before Me, says the LORD. And so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there [is] unclean.

entries.title: Haggai 2:15
segments: And now, I ask you, set your heart on it; from this day and onward, before the placing of a stone on a stone in the temple of the LORD;

entries.title: Haggai 2:16
segments: from then onward, [one] came to a heap of twenty [measures], and there were [but] ten; one came to the wine vat to draw off fifty from the winepress, and there were [but] twenty.

entries.title: Haggai 2:17
segments: I struck you with blight and with mildew, and with hail, in all the labors of your hands; yet you did not [turn] to Me, says the LORD.

entries.title: Haggai 2:18
segments: Now set your heart from this day and forward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth [month], from the day that the LORD's temple was founded. Set your heart:

entries.title: Haggai 2:19
segments: [Is] the seed still in the barn? Yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, have not brought forth. From this day I will bless [you].

entries.title: Haggai 2:20
segments: And a second time the word of the LORD came to Haggai in the twenty-fourth of the month, saying,

entries.title: Haggai 2:21
segments: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth.

entries.title: Haggai 2:22
segments: And I will overthrow the throne of the kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. And I will overthrow the chariots and their riders. And the horses and their riders shall come down, each one by the sword of his brother.

entries.title: Haggai 2:23
segments: In that day, says the LORD of hosts, I will take you, O Zerubbabel, My servant, the son of Shealtiel, says the LORD, and will make you like a signet; for I have chosen you, says the LORD of hosts.
